written.headline: AI unlocks Kurt Gödel's notebooks to reveal hundreds of proved theorems
written.summary: Researchers used the AI model Claude to analyze 1,009 pages of Kurt Gödel's 1940s notebooks written in obsolete German shorthand. The AI processed the material within days, revealing hundreds of proved theorems and mathematical discoveries.

written.headline: OpenAI board member warns AI accident is likely cause of death
written.summary: OpenAI Foundation board member Paul Cristiano warned that an AI accident is the most likely cause of death for most people in his audience. He stated there is a meaningful risk of an AI takeover occurring within the next six to 12 months.

written.headline: Nvidia board says it is selecting a search firm for the CEO role
written.summary: Nvidia's board stated it is selecting a search firm for the chief executive officer role following the exit of former CEO Jensen Huang. The board noted that it has not yet formally engaged any potential candidates.

written.headline: Dario Amodei calls computing capacity planning Anthropic's deepest business dilemma
written.summary: Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei stated that determining how much computing power is needed years in advance is the company's deepest business dilemma due to unpredictable revenue. Anthropic disclosed $900.9 billion in long-term commitments stretching through 2045, with $70.7 billion due by September 30, 2027.

written.headline: Anthropic IPO excludes mainland China and Hong Kong investors
written.summary: Institutional investors based in mainland China and Hong Kong are excluded from placing orders in Anthropic's initial public offering. The restriction is partly due to US arms export rules, similar to restrictions applied to SpaceX.
